text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...It's simply a lack of ability on my part...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...If I sink in a place like this... I'll never... reach that back...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...'Don't give up', huh.........
Idealistic pep talks like that... I don't see how they're of any use..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...But with my current skill, I just can't...
choice_data_list: Are you just going to leave it at a loss?
Are you really okay with leaving it like that, as a loss?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...But with my current skill, I just can't...
choice_data_list: Are you just going to leave it at a loss?
Are you really okay with leaving it like that, as a loss?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...The next race... is it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, that back... is only getting further away...
Next time... to catch up—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even if I give up here... that back will only get further away.
So—"don't give up"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... let's get right to training.
...We can't afford to just stand around, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tap)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, "something"
suddenly brushed against my back...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Have a safe trip."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant, I felt as though I had touched "something" emotional...
Stirred by those feelings,
I hurriedly chased after her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...If things stay like this...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I...... don't want that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if responding to her words, the air in the room grew a bit colder...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............
...Aiming for the summit... and continuing to march forward...
T H A T ' S  G O O D

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Must have been hearing things.
Looks like I psyched myself up a bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
"Everyone"... thank you so much...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I won't lose anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We're both fully fired up.
Let's move forward toward the next race.
